tags.name: Perriman's Row
tags.note: Section of road is two-way, but OSM offers no way to tag no entry to a two way road. Help page has contribution suggesting creating a short length of one way.
Exists, but overgrown by shrubs. Local information is that ownership of footway is disputed resulting in no maintanance and being overgrown by plants.
